author: BJPickles
description: Year-in-review snapshots piggy-backing on LevelUp stats
short: Annual & periodic Year-in-Review snapshots for LevelUp
install_msg: AGSProfiles requires Vertyco's LevelUp cog to be installed and loaded first: `[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`, `[p]cog install vrt-cogs levelup`, then `[p]load levelup`. After that, load AGSProfiles and run `[p]agsnapshot manual`. Python libraries (Pydantic 2.11 and Pillow) are installed by Downloader; required_cogs is informational and does not install LevelUp automatically.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord IDs, snapshot timestamps, and aggregated LevelUp statistics. No other user data is stored.
